extraction.Name: Henry Young
extraction.Recorded patent: Patent recorded Jul. 1, 1921, by Bennett County Bank, Martin, So. D.
extraction.Buyer: SE 25-37-34 deeded to Homer B. Skeen, Cody, Nebr. by Henry Young and Viola Young, his wife, for $3000.00, on Jan. 23, 1923; On May 2, 1921, mortgaged to Bennett County Bank, Martin, So. Dak. for $416.85; On May 4, 1921, mortgaged to Homer B. Skeen of Cody, Nebr. for $639.20; On Dec. 6, 1922, Bennett County Bank, Martin, So. Dak. assigned to Homer B. Skeen, mortgage for $438.39
extraction.NOTES: Receipt dated Jun. 20, 1918. Land described as SE 25-37-34. H. B. Skeen of Cody, Nebr. on Jan. 25, 1923, signs Satisfaction of Mortgage to Bennett County Bank, Martin, So. Dak. dated May 2, 1921, recorded Jan. 29, 1923. H. B. Skeen of Cody, Nebr. on Jan. 25, 1923, signs Satisfaction of Mortgage to himself on SE 25-37-34, dated May 4, 1921, recorded Jan. 29, 1923. Wife named Viola Young.
